description: Web access-log attack scanner — Scan Apache/Nginx access-log lines for attacks: path traversal, SQL injection, XSS, secrets probes (.env/.git), admin probes, RCE/Log4Shell, scanner tools. Returns verdict CLEAN/SUSPICIOUS/UNDER ATTACK/POSSIBLE COMPROMISE, attack requests that got 2xx, top IPs cross-checked against Polyform first-party honeypot, block candidates and fixes. GET ?text=<log lines> or ?url=<plain-text log file, max 1MB, 5000 lines>. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
